Actually, digging into this a bit more it looks like Chromium doesn't do this right now - the device service [checks this and returns failure if there's a mismatch](https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:services/device/hid/hid_connection.cc;l=98-102;drc=584159394114a18259b1af8327df3868b36b22ac), which gets [turned into a NotAllowedError DOMException](https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:third_party/blink/renderer/modules/hid/hid_device.cc;l=536-537;drc=557d18d6e337bab85172345226da54e2f770682b). (and similar code for `sendFeatureReport()`/`receiveFeatureReport()`)

On balance I think it would be nice to return some sort of different error here since passing the wrong report ID (i.e. zero vs. non-zero) seems like a pretty different problem than calling a protected report. What do you think @nondebug ?
